Glad it's working. I saved this to the project's memory: newer wkhtmltopdf versions need `--enable-local-file-access`, or the invoice PDF tests fail. It should come up the next time someone runs into it.

The repo has no uncommitted changes, so your fix is probably only in your local setup. If that's the case, CI and teammates with a newer wkhtmltopdf will hit the same failure. It may be worth adding the flag wherever the code calls wkhtmltopdf. I can look for that call and add the flag if you'd like.
